info.title: deposit.now — Open x402 funding rail
info.description: Open x402 deposit API: pay 0.25% USDC on Base or Solana (min $0.001, max $0.25); net forwards to target on the same chain after settlement. Optional managed child wallets via provision:true (CDP Server Wallet on Base, platform-managed keys — no key export in v1). Optional public receipts. Complements Coinbase CDP Fund/Send. HTTP 200 payment_received does not guarantee funds already arrived at target.
info.x-guidance: POST /api/deposit with { target, amount, memo? } OR { provision: true, label, amount, memo? }. EVM target → pay on Base. Solana target → pay on Solana. Unpaid → 402 for gross = amount + 0.25% (min $0.001, max $0.25). Paid → payment_received + receiptUrl. Check forwardStatus on the receipt. Docs: https://deposit.now/docs

post.summary: Pay via x402 to fund a target or provisioned child wallet (net forward async)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for provision mode when label is omitted or for extra uniqueness

target.description: Base EVM (0x) or Solana (base58) address receiving net USDC. Omit when provision is true. Pay the 402 on the same chain as this address.

amount.description: Net USDC to forward to target (agent pays this + 0.25%, min $0.001, max $0.25)

provision.description: If true, create/resolve a managed CDP child wallet and fund it. Do not send target.

label.description: Stable child label (lowercase, digits, hyphens). Required with provision unless Idempotency-Key is set.

200.description: Payment accepted. Forwarding is async — inspect receiptUrl / forwardStatus.

status.description: payment_received means x402 payment accepted, not that target already holds net funds

402.description: Payment required. Pay amount + 0.25% USDC (min $0.001, max $0.25) via x402 exact scheme on Base or Solana (match target chain). Body includes target and optional child when provisioned.

400.description: Invalid target, amount, or provision parameters (ambiguous_target, missing_target, invalid_label, missing_provision_identity).

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (including provision rate limit).
